audience: store owners and shop staff who run orders, products and customers in WooCommerce

useCases.title: Review orders that are on hold
useCases.text: List orders filtered by status, such as on-hold. Open one to read its line items, shipping address and totals, and its notes.

useCases.title: Check sales and top sellers for a period
useCases.text: Read the sales report for a period: gross and net sales, orders, refunds and discounts. Then list the best-selling products of that period.

useCases.title: Find products that are low on stock
useCases.text: List products filtered by stock status or search text. Open one to read its stock quantity and variation ids.

useCases.title: Change a product price or its sale
useCases.text: Set the regular price of a product, and its sale price. Pass an empty sale price to end the sale. The live price changes at once.

useCases.title: Update an order status and add a note
useCases.text: Set an order to a status such as processing or completed. Add an internal note, which the customer does not see. WooCommerce may e-mail the customer for the status.
